title: Jimmy Carter's 1969 UFO sighting
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jimmy Carter's 1969 UFO sighting, about 1969 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: President Carter remember had seen a UFO Y in 1969

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing a man named Dan Sheehan, reminds listeners that Jimmy Carter, the future US president, had seen a UFO, an unidentified flying object, in 1969. If so, it would mean even a man who went on to lead the country saw something he could not explain.
